subject_id_evidence: No explicit subject/person ID field was found. Filenames use cluster_<0-7>_<image_id>, where cluster maps 1:1 to blood-group folder. Numeric image_ids are unique across the whole dataset (0..5999 style indexing), so they behave like global sample indices, not verified participant IDs. Near-duplicate aHash grouping is an imperfect proxy and must not be treated as true subjects.
